sources.label: AllUnity CHFAU product and reserve disclosure

reserveReview.rationale: AllUnity describes CHFAU as fully backed 1:1 by CHF reserves held at CRR credit institutions in the European Union and segregated from its operational funds. Its trust center says a reserve audit report is coming soon, so no institution-level allocation can be substantiated.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AllUnity issuer reserve and trust-center disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve institutions, account shares, and a dated independent reserve report are not public.
